key_fields.name: SEC-USR-PWD
key_fields.meaning: 8-character password stored in clear text in the record layout.

key_fields.name: SEC-USR-TYPE
key_fields.meaning: 1-character user type (admin/user, see CDEMO-USER-TYPE in COCOM01Y).

observations.text: COACTUPC copies CSUSR01Y but references no SEC-USR field.
The password field is a plain PIC X(08) with no hashing indicated by the layout.

purpose: Defines SEC-USER-DATA, the 80-byte signed-on user security record: user id, first and last name, password, user type and filler. It is the record used by the sign-on and user-maintenance programs; COACTUPC copies it but does not reference any of its fields.
